entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your undying optimism keeps you and your companions going even when things get rough.

Prerequisite(s): Halfling, fearless and halfling luck racial traits.

Benefit(s): Adjacent allies who also have this feat gain a +1 morale bonus on all saving throws. This bonus increases to +3 on saving throws against fear.
